templates.why_chosen: High-confidence, dense layered exemplar that partitions the whole architecture into three separately dashed-bordered quadrants rather than horizontal bands, colour-coding each quadrant's own role boxes across 15 components and 12 flows.
templates.what_to_learn: When a system's levels are conceptual rather than physically stacked, arrange them as separate dashed-bordered quadrants labelled by level name instead of forcing strict top-down bands, and show a before/after transition as two small boxes joined by one arrow inside its own quadrant.
